contentPattern.summary: One item row per slide. Cells: image | optional video URL | rich text. All slides sit in a horizontal row; the active slide expands to full width and reveals its text below the media, others stay as narrow image strips. Hover, click or focus activates a slide.

cells: image (poster when a video is set)
rich text: optional heading, description paragraph, optional link

reuseGuidance: Use for accordion-like horizontal galleries where the focused item widens. Options: alt (bottom-aligned media of varying height, active slide is tallest), alt-2 (same layout with video slides). For centered auto-advancing cards use carousel-coverflow.
usageDescription: Expanding image-strip gallery: feature highlights (heading + description, optional Saiba mais link) and speaker galleries (name, role, LinkedIn link).
